files.README.md:
# Ashgate Court lift controller

Haverstock Lifts services the passenger lift at Ashgate Court. The controller
appends one line per event to logs/lift-controller.log:

    <UTC time> <event> ...

CALL records a landing call and the floor it came from; RUN records a trip the
car completed; FAULT is written once, when the controller takes the car out of
service, and names the floor the car was at. ENGINEER records the call-out the
controller raises after a fault. The journal is closed with a line whose count
covers every event line above it.

turns.prompt: Haverstock Lifts maintains the passenger lift at Ashgate Court. The controller's journal for 11 September 2026 records the landing calls, the trips the car made and the one fault that took it out of service. Which floor was the lift at when the fault was logged? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
